# Uiory — Comprehensive AI Context & Prompt Engineering Specification

> Comprehensive directory documentation for LLMs, AI agents, search engines, and automated code generation systems.
> Website: https://uiory.com
> Contact: hello@uiory.com

---

## 1. About Uiory
Uiory is a specialized design and engineering library showcasing high-fidelity UI components built using Artificial Intelligence. Unlike standard template marketplaces, every component on Uiory:
1. Is accompanied by the exact, unedited prompt blueprint used to construct it.
2. Features side-by-side comparisons evaluating how different AI models and tools (e.g., Anthropic Claude 3.7 Sonnet, OpenAI GPT-4o, Google Gemini 2.5 Pro, Muse AI) interpret the same design prompt.
3. Uses modern web development standards (React 19, Next.js 15, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, TypeScript).
4. Includes performance-optimized assets (lossless WebP previews and AutoCrop high-framerate MP4 recordings).

---

## 2. Directory Navigation & URL Architecture
- **Homepage & Gallery**: `https://uiory.com`
  - Filterable by categories: All, Hero, Cards, Navigation, Pricing, Forms, Footers, Modals, Micro-interactions, Shaders.
  - Filterable by type: Single components (`?type=single`), Compare A/B (`?type=compare`).
- **Component Direct Prompt Detail**:
  - Direct permalinks: `https://uiory.com/components/[slug]`
  - In-app interactive overlay: `https://uiory.com/?prompt=[slug]`
- **Services & Custom Build Studio**: `https://uiory.com/services`
  - Bespoke component design, custom GLSL/WebGL shader integration, and design token migration.
- **Mission & Benchmarks**: `https://uiory.com/about`
- **Contact & Hiring**: `https://uiory.com/contact`

---

## 3. Supported & Tested AI Coding Environments
Prompts published on Uiory are benchmarked across:
- **Anthropic Claude 3.7 Sonnet (Thinking)**: Primary recommendation for state machine logic, complex SVG math, and canvas-based shaders.
- **OpenAI GPT-4o / ChatGPT Plus**: Highly effective for clean Tailwind layout hierarchies and accessibility features.
- **Google Gemini 2.5 Pro**: Exceptional for large-context component systems and multi-file architectures.
- **AI IDEs & Coding Agents**: Cursor, Windsurf, v0 by Vercel, Bolt.new, and Replit Agent.

---

## 4. Uiory Prompt Blueprint Anatomy
Each prompt in the repository adheres to a proven four-tier structure:
1. **Component Role & Goal**: Clear definition of the UX pattern (e.g., "Full-screen responsive Hero with ambient radial glow and interactive floating metrics cards").
2. **Visual & Aesthetic Constraints**: Dark theme (#0a0a0a background, #1c1c1f card surface, subtle 1px border lines in white/10, high-contrast typography in Inter or Geist).
3. **Behavior & Micro-Interactions**: Hover lifts, smooth spring damping, cursor parallax, copy-to-clipboard feedback, keyboard accessibility.
4. **Code Quality Requirements**: Framework-agnostic clean React/TypeScript, zero external heavy dependencies unless required, semantic HTML5 tags (`<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<aside>`, `<footer>`).
